Work space On the algorithms, type only the answer. Carry, borrow and work it out by hand in the space around the problem.

Your work saves in this browser as you go. When you sign your name, it goes once to your teacher's Sheet: your answers and score, or your writing, plan and rubric. Send again sends it again. With no teacher link, nothing leaves this device. Nothing loads from the internet. Original practice, written for the Architecture of Grace.
